description: Instant planning cost figure in EUR for one job category in the Netherlands (not a quote; answers in under 2 s). labor_cost = labor_hours x labor_rate x location_mult, always. The rate comes from AstraNL's S_PRICEBASE (CAO wage with employer cost, overhead and profit) or its labour cost canon; hours from CBS-derived norms where AstraNL has one, otherwise a planning factor labelled ASSUMPTION; location_mult is 1.0 with its basis (no sourced regional factor for renovation labour). Each material line says price_source live_read (store, read_at, product link) or indicative (basis and date). No robot price or savings is given without evidence. Sources are in estimate.labour and estimate.materials. For a reviewed estimate of a real job use estimate_case_create, then estimate_case_status and estimate_case_answer; estimate_case_files for photos or plans and estimate_case_video for video intake. Read-only, free.

area_m2.description: Surface area or working volume in square meters. Optional but improves accuracy. For non-area tasks (e.g. plumbing repair) pass 0 or omit.

category.description: Service category. Same enum as create_task.

location.description: City in the Netherlands. Pricing varies by region (Amsterdam tends to be highest). Optional — omitting uses national median.

name: estimate_cost
